summary: A social media manager who handles accounts for roughly five clients and came looking for Instagram account recoveries after two client accounts were disabled. In August I quoted $3,200 per account; he said his usual guy was overcharging and that he could bring repeat business. In late October he returned with another disabled account, claimed a competitor offered $2,500, and proposed $3,000 total paid as $1,500 on recovery plus $1,500 three days later. He says he filled out the required form, told me the reps estimated 24 hours, and as of 10/27 was asking when work would start. Name never given; no payment app or sign-off in the thread.
